+@pytest.mark.parametrize('error, wording', [
+    (QProcess.FailedToStart, 'failed to start'),
+    (QProcess.Crashed, 'crashed'),
+    (QProcess.Timedout, 'timed out'),
+    (QProcess.WriteError, 'write error'),
+    (QProcess.ReadError, 'read error'),
+])
+def test_error_types(fake_proc, message_mock, monkeypatch, caplog, error,
+                     wording):
+    """Each QProcess error has a message identifying the command and type."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, 'is_windows', True)
+    fake_proc.cmd = 'example-command'
+    fake_proc._proc.errorString.return_value = 'error detail'
+
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
+        fake_proc._on_error(error)
+
+    msg = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.error)
+    assert msg.text == "Testprocess 'example-command' {}: error detail".format(
+        wording)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('detail', [

+    'Permission denied',

+])
+def test_failed_to_start_hint(fake_proc, message_mock, monkeypatch, caplog,
+                              detail):
+    """A startup failure due to an unusable command includes a Unix hint."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, 'is_windows', False)
+    fake_proc.cmd = 'example-command'
+    fake_proc._proc.errorString.return_value = detail
+
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
+        fake_proc._on_error(QProcess.FailedToStart)
+
+    msg = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.error)
+    assert msg.text == (
+        "Testprocess 'example-command' failed to start: {} "
+        "(Hint: Make sure 'example-command' exists and is executable)"
+    ).format(detail)
